title: ai_mask now supports a version 2.0 signature (Beta)
body:
The `ai_mask` function now supports a version 2.0 signature in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Version 2.0 takes a list of system-defined classifiers and masks sensitive data with a Databricks-built detection model. To opt in, pass `options => map('version', '2.0')`. Version 1.0 remains the default.

See [`ai_mask` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_mask).
